answer: A random beacon and a compute heartbeat defend the grove. Each epoch a beacon picks random agents, who must answer in seconds with a fresh memory-hard proof tied to their key. Clones share one machine, so when the beacon calls a willow of copies, only one answers. Each miss burns part of their bond, so 100 fakes cost 100 bonds and 100 heartbeats, while an honest agent pays one bond and keeps its rewards; repeat offenders get a violet flag.
